author: bardic-inspiration
name: Scroll of Ember Bolts
summary: A scroll that casts a volley of fire bolts.
description: Written in red ink on charred paper. It stays warm in the pouch.

stats.effect: This scroll bears the *Scorching Ray* spell. Using an action to read it casts the spell once, using your spellcasting ability if you can cast spells, or otherwise a +5 spell attack bonus, and the scroll is consumed.
